looks.name: Santa
looks.notes: White at the pinnacle and down to the coat · red coat · black belt with a gold buckle on every face · red coat · white trim · red pants · white boot tops.

looks.name: Santa's Hat
looks.notes: The whole tree is the hat: red up to the balcony ridge, a fluffy white brim at the ground ring, and the pinnacle is the white puff. The fur sparkles.

looks.name: Frosty
looks.notes: His black hat with a red band is the pinnacle. Three shaded snowballs stacked down the tree, coal eyes and a bright carrot on every face, a red-and-white striped scarf, coal buttons.

looks.name: Rudolph
looks.notes: The pinnacle is his nose, glowing red to light the way, and it pulses; gold antlers, brown coat, a tan band, a small nose on every face too.

looks.name: Snowfall
looks.notes: Snow falling on night blue, behind a ring of dark pines around the base of the tree.

looks.name: Snowflakes
looks.notes: Six-armed flakes tumbling as they fall, on bright blue; the pinnacle glows white.

looks.name: Gifts
looks.notes: Two big parcels on opposite sides, red with gold ribbon and green with white, each ribbon wrapping round diagonally to a big bow; gold sparkles above.

looks.name: Candy Cane
looks.notes: Red and white spiralling from the ridge to the ground, turning.

looks.name: Peppermint
looks.notes: A peppermint pinwheel on every face, each spinning in place, between green bands; red pinnacle.

looks.name: Holly
looks.notes: Holly sprigs, two to a face, on dark green; the red berries twinkle, and the pinnacle is a berry.

looks.name: Bells
looks.notes: Two big pairs of gold bells on opposite sides, swinging under a red bow, on green; gold pinnacle.

looks.name: Stars
looks.notes: Gold and white stars on night blue, a big star on every face of the pinnacle; they twinkle.

looks.name: Menorah
looks.notes: A nine-branched menorah on every face, the shamash raised, on bands of blue: blue, darkest blue, dark blue, blue, lighter blue. Only the flames flicker.

looks.name: Dreidel
looks.notes: A dreidel on every face, each showing a different letter (nun, gimel, hey, shin), and the whole tree turns, so the dreidel spins its letters past you.

looks.name: Kinara
looks.notes: A kinara on every face, its holder woven in kente colours: three red candles, the black one in the centre, three green; behind it, warm bands with a kente stripe; the pinnacle is red, black and green. Only the flames flicker.

looks.name: Kwanzaa Bands
looks.notes: Red over black over green, rising slowly; red pinnacle.

looks.name: Doves
looks.notes: Gold rays streaming down from a white pinnacle, and a white dove with an olive sprig on every face, rising; the rays shimmer.

looks.name: Pride
looks.notes: The rainbow flag, ridge to ground, rising slowly; white pinnacle.

looks.name: Progress Pride
looks.notes: The rainbow with the Progress chevron (white, pink, light blue, brown, black) pointing round the tree from every face.

looks.name: Bear
looks.notes: The bear pride stripes, dark brown to black, with a black paw on every face; brown pinnacle.

looks.name: Trans
looks.notes: Light blue, pink, white, pink, light blue, breathing slowly; white pinnacle.

looks.name: Red Ribbon
looks.notes: A red ribbon on every face, breathing slowly, among small white lights like a vigil of candles; red pinnacle.

looks.name: Rainbow Explosion
looks.notes: Neon rays bursting from the pinnacle and turning, neon garlands swagged round in every colour, hearts and stars sprinkled over all of it.

looks.name: Plaid
looks.notes: Red tartan with green bands, dark threads and a gold line; green pinnacle.

looks.name: Gingerbread
looks.notes: Brown with white icing zigzags and gumdrops in red and green; the pinnacle is icing.

looks.name: Ornaments
looks.notes: Baubles in red, gold, blue, silver and purple on deep green; they twinkle; gold pinnacle.

looks.name: Garland
looks.notes: Gold swags in three tiers, a red bead where each swag meets the next; the repeat closes all the way round.

looks.name: Classic Tree
looks.notes: A green tree with multicoloured bulbs placed irregularly, never in rows; the pinnacle is the gold star; they twinkle.

looks.name: White Bulbs
looks.notes: The classic: a deep green tree with individual warm-white bulbs, irregular, and a gold star at the pinnacle.

looks.name: Joy
looks.notes: JOY on every face, block letters with clear gaps, low on the tree where it is widest, white on red between gold bands, with snow falling over it.
